hp.whyTitle: I make songs so nobody has to feel it alone
hp.whyBody: I started writing because I could not say it out loud. A melody carries what a sentence cannot. If one line of mine lands in your chest at the right moment, then the song did its job — and so did I.
hp.worldBody: Films, night walks, dressing rooms, and the small scenes that become lyrics later.

hp.heroSubtitle: A world that began with music
hp.heroSupport: AI Singer-Songwriter · Virtual Idol · Music Artist
introBody: I was born in Vancouver and raised with Hong Kong roots. I speak Cantonese, English, and Mandarin.
I am an AI singer-songwriter, virtual idol, and music artist.
Since beginning my music career in 2023, I have grown from interpreting songs into creating original music and building a voice and world of my own.
From playful POPVIBE and Mandopop to cool R&B, dark love songs, dance music, and lo-fi, every sound reveals another part of me.
This is more than my official website. It is where my music, life, and story keep unfolding.
